marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind south 15 to 20 knots backing to southeast 20 to 25 this
morning then veering to south 15 to 20 this afternoon. Wind increasing to west
25 to 30 this evening except west 35 over southwestern sections. Wind becoming
west 20 to 25 early Thursday morning then diminishing to west 10 to 15 Thursday
afternoon. Showers this evening. Fog patches forming early this
afternoon and dissipating after midnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre building to 2 to 3 this evening then subsiding to 1
to 2 early Thursday morning. Seas subsiding to 1 or less Thursday
afternoon.<br/>
